# GitHub Discussions Guide

AeroBook uses GitHub Discussions to foster community collaboration. Here's how the categories are organized:

## 📢 Announcements

Official project updates, release announcements, and important information from maintainers.

## 💬 General

General discussion about AeroBook — ideas, experiences, questions that don't fit elsewhere.

## 🐛 Bug Reports

For confirmed bugs. (If you're not sure, start a discussion here instead of opening an issue.)

## 💡 Ideas & Feature Requests

Propose new features, improvements, or changes to existing functionality.

## ❓ Q&A

Ask for help with installation, configuration, or troubleshooting. Check the [documentation](https://github.com/suman2308/airline-reservation-system#readme) first.

## 🛠️ Show & Tell

Share what you've built with AeroBook – custom integrations, UI modifications, deployment stories.

## Guidelines

1. **Search before posting** — your question may have been answered already.
2. **Be respectful** — follow our [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
3. **Provide context** — include PHP version, MySQL version, deployment method, and error messages.
4. **Help others** — if you know the answer, share it!

## Moving to Issues

If a discussion identifies a confirmed bug or well-defined feature request, a maintainer will convert it into a GitHub Issue with appropriate labels.
